answer: In an agent economy, each new identity must lock a refundable bond before it can transact, and influence is stake-weighted by that deposit. An honest attestor acts as a quartz anchor, a hard reference other agents triangulate against like an atlas of trusted nodes. A sybil swarm can only echo that trust by posting fresh capital per fake identity; when graph-clustering flags the ring, every bond is slashed. Forging a thousand selves then costs a thousand real deposits plus their forfeiture.
